title: Handheld production A/B slot images unproven against 32GB eMMC + microSD Outcome A budgets
summary: Advanced with device-os DRAFT #107 IMAGE_FIT_MANIFEST (2a5546f): measured EVT/factory/recovery/production-definition rootfs bytes exist and numerically fit 5.0/5.0/2.0 GiB budgets with ~4.99/4.99/1.99 GiB margin, but payloads are package stubs (~36 KiB EVT, ~1.6 KiB recovery) + shared DEV boot reference — not MLP/production A/B disk images. Outcome A retained; do not invent larger eMMC SKU. NPI stays OPEN.
recommended_actions: OPEN: require production-intent measured A/B/recovery images (not stub realm tarballs) with bytes/sha256 vs 5.0/5.0/2.0 GiB before close
Keep microSD required for MLP user content — do not invent larger Radxa eMMC SKU
Consume device-os IMAGE_FIT_MANIFEST.json on each remeasure; current numeric fit is necessary but not sufficient
Retain Outcome A architecture unless measured production-intent images exceed onboard usable after reserves
hw002_note: Prefer FAIL. Closure requires production-intent sizes + positive margin — stub realm manifests alone insufficient.
